CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	entity VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id INTEGER, 
	extra_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE automation_triggers (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	keyword VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	match_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	comment_reply_text TEXT, 
	dm_reply_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	attachment_url VARCHAR(1024), 
	attachment_name VARCHAR(255), 
	followup_text TEXT, 
	target_pipeline_stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	trigger_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE customers (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255), 
	username VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(64), 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	instagram_id VARCHAR(128), 
	whatsapp_id VARCHAR(128), 
	notes TEXT, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	extra_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_contact_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	role_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	preferred_language VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	parent_contact_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_customers_instagram_id ON customers (instagram_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_customers_whatsapp_id ON customers (whatsapp_id)

CREATE TABLE employee_metrics (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	position VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT metric_direction CHECK (direction IN ('higher', 'lower')), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE enrolled_students (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	country VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	process_stage VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	manager VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	next_action VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	risk VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	comment TEXT, 
	is_completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status_raw VARCHAR(64), 
	contract_amount VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	paid_amount VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	remaining_amount VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	seller_commission_paid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mentor_commission_paid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	next_payment_condition VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	last_payment_date VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	finance_comment TEXT, 
	full_payment_received BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE finance_categories (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE sellers (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(64), 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE services (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(128), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
	key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

CREATE TABLE university_programs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	university VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	faculty VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	program_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	program_name_ru VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	degree_level VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tuition_fee VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tuition_fee_usd FLOAT, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	duration VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	country VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_events (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_webhook_events_event_id ON webhook_events (event_id)

CREATE TABLE whatsapp_accounts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(32), 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_main BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_whatsapp_accounts_account_id ON whatsapp_accounts (account_id)

CREATE TABLE bookings (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	booking_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	service_id INTEGER, 
	service_name_snapshot VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	price_snapshot FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scheduled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	meeting_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	meeting_location VARCHAR(512), 
	customer_name VARCHAR(255), 
	customer_phone VARCHAR(64), 
	customer_email VARCHAR(255), 
	notes TEXT, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	cancelled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(service_id) REFERENCES services (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_status_date ON bookings (status, scheduled_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_bookings_booking_number ON bookings (booking_number)

CREATE TABLE conversations (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	whatsapp_account_id INTEGER, 
	mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	unread_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_message_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(whatsapp_account_id) REFERENCES whatsapp_accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_conv_cust_channel ON conversations (customer_id, channel)

CREATE TABLE seller_kpi_records (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	seller_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	punctuality FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	calls_meetings FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	sales FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	team_meetings FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	innovation FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	total_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	evaluator VARCHAR(128), 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES sellers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE student_profiles (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	current_grade_or_status VARCHAR(128), 
	school_or_university VARCHAR(255), 
	gpa FLOAT, 
	language_tests JSON NOT NULL, 
	target_countries JSON NOT NULL, 
	target_degree VARCHAR(64), 
	planned_year INTEGER, 
	budget_expectation VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_student_profiles_customer_id ON student_profiles (customer_id)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	whatsapp_account_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(whatsapp_account_id) REFERENCES whatsapp_accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

CREATE TABLE company_leads (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assigned_user_id INTEGER, 
	category VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	next_action VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (customer_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE deals (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_country VARCHAR(128), 
	target_degree VARCHAR(64), 
	amount FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	lost_reason VARCHAR(255), 
	assigned_user_id INTEGER, 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE employee_results (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	period DATE NOT NULL, 
	target NUMERIC(18, 2) NOT NULL, 
	actual NUMERIC(18, 2) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evaluated_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT employee_metric_period UNIQUE (user_id, metric_id, period), 
	CONSTRAINT employee_result_values CHECK (target > 0 AND actual >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(metric_id) REFERENCES employee_metrics (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(evaluated_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE messages (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	external_message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	sender_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT, 
	attachments JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	extra_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX idx_msg_conv_created ON messages (conversation_id, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_messages_external_message_id ON messages (external_message_id)

CREATE TABLE student_documents (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES enrolled_students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (storage_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(uploaded_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE company_admissions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER, 
	deal_id INTEGER, 
	manager_id INTEGER, 
	program_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (student_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES enrolled_students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (customer_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (deal_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(deal_id) REFERENCES deals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(manager_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(program_id) REFERENCES university_programs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE document_checklists (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	deal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	file_url VARCHAR(1024), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(deal_id) REFERENCES deals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE finance_transactions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(18, 2) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_on DATE NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER, 
	deal_id INTEGER, 
	stage VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	recipient VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	commission_percent NUMERIC(5, 2), 
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	voided_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	void_reason TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT finance_positive_amount CHECK (amount > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT finance_kind CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')), 
	CONSTRAINT finance_commission_range CHECK (commission_percent IS NULL OR (commission_percent >= 0 AND commission_percent <= 100)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES finance_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES enrolled_students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(deal_id) REFERENCES deals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
